originalSentence: I don't have money, so I can't buy it.
instruction: 가정법 과거로 전환하시오 (현재 사실의 반대를 가정)
options: If I have money, I can buy it.
If I had money, I could buy it.
If I had had money, I could have bought it.
If I have had money, I could buy it.
explanation: 현재 사실의 반대 가정이므로 If + 주어 + 동사 과거형, 주절은 could + 동사원형이 옵니다.

originalSentence: She didn't study hard, so she failed the exam.
instruction: 가정법 과거완료로 전환하시오 (과거 사실의 반대를 가정)
options: If she studied hard, she would pass the exam.
If she had studied hard, she would have passed the exam.
If she had studied hard, she would pass the exam.
If she has studied hard, she would have passed the exam.
explanation: 과거 사실의 반대 가정이므로 If + 주어 + had p.p., 주절은 would have p.p.가 옵니다.

originalSentence: He is not rich, so he can't buy the house.
options: If he were rich, he could buy the house.
If he was rich, he could buy the house.
If he is rich, he can buy the house.
If he had been rich, he could have bought the house.
explanation: 가정법 과거에서 be동사는 인칭·수와 상관없이 were를 쓰는 것이 표준 문어체 규칙입니다.
